Welcome to the ObservableScrollView library demonstration. This showcase highlights the powerful features available for creating smooth scroll-based animations and interactive user experiences in your Android applications.

This library provides parallax scrolling effects, toolbar color transitions, scroll state tracking, direction detection, and much more. All features are easily configurable through XML attributes or programmatically in your code.

Simply add the ObservableScrollView to your layout XML, configure the desired attributes, and implement the listener interface to respond to scroll events. The library handles all the complex scroll calculations for you.
For advanced use cases, you can enable sticky headers, implement quick-return patterns, or create custom scroll-based animations. Check the documentation for complete examples and best practices.
